scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.dev:app:lan: LAN=$(corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run --silent lan-address) && echo "Serving to phones on http://$LAN:8081 (API http://$LAN:3001)" && EXPO_HOST=lan EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://$LAN:3001 corepack pnpm --filter @workspace/inmycity run dev
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run typecheck:libs && corepack pnpm -r --filter @workspace/api-server --filter @workspace/inmycity --filter @workspace/scripts --if-present run typecheck
